story.title: Story
story.description: The ÜÜR story: from the Gobi to the mill, and how cashmere comes to be.
story.headline: From the Gobi dawn
story.lead: The path from a cold Gobi night to the soft warmth on your shoulders.
story.intro: Cashmere is the goat's soft undercoat — grown against the winter cold and gently combed out in spring. This page follows its journey.

map.label: Map of the journey from the Gobi to the mill

gobi.title: Cold nights, soft down
gobi.body: Through the Gobi winter, goats grow a fine undercoat. When spring warms, it is combed out.

mid.title: Across the steppe
mid.body: From the herder's ger, the raw fibre travels the steppe roads.

factory.title: From fibre to yarn
factory.body: Here the fibre is cleaned, spun and knit.

quotes.steppe: The steppe is never in a hurry.

comb.title: Combing
comb.body: In spring, the soft undercoat is gently combed from the goat.

clean.title: Cleaning
clean.body: Washed and parted from coarse hair and dust, until only the soft down remains.

spin.title: Spinning
spin.body: The fine fibres are twisted into an even, strong yarn.

knit.title: Knitting
knit.body: Loop by loop, the yarn becomes soft cloth.
